title.zh: 拨款25,000菲律宾比索或必要金额，赔偿黎刹省 Mariquina 和 San Mateo 市镇土地所有者及居民因岛屿政府为保护马尼拉市供水免受霍乱感染而采取检疫措施遭受的损失
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, OR SO MUCH THEREOF AS MAY BE NECESSARY, FOR THE PAYMENT OF CLAIMS FOR DAMAGES SUSTAINED BY THE LANDOWNERS AND RESIDENTS OF THE MUNICIPALITIES OF MARIQUINA AND SAN MATEO, IN THE PROVINCE OF RIZAL, ON ACCOUNT OF THE QUARANTINE MEASURES ADOPTED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT TO PROTECT THE WATER SUPPLY OF THE CITY OF MANILA FROM INFECTION WITH CHOLERA.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, OR SO MUCH THEREOF AS MAY BE NECESSARY, FOR THE PAYMENT OF CLAIMS FOR DAMAGES SUSTAINED BY THE LANDOWNERS AND RESIDENTS OF THE MUNICIPALITIES OF MARIQUINA AND SAN MATEO, IN THE PROVINCE OF RIZAL, ON ACCOUNT OF THE QUARANTINE MEASURES ADOPTED BY THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT TO PROTECT THE WATER SUPPLY OF THE CITY OF MANILA FROM INFECTION WITH CHOLERA.
title.vi: Luật cấp 25.000 peso Philippines hoặc khoản cần thiết để bồi thường thiệt hại cho chủ đất và cư dân Mariquina, San Mateo, tỉnh Rizal, do biện pháp cách ly bảo vệ nguồn nước Manila khỏi bệnh tả
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรเงิน 25,000 เปโซฟิลิปปินส์หรือเท่าที่จำเป็นเพื่อชดเชยความเสียหายแก่เจ้าของที่ดินและประชาชนใน Mariquina และ San Mateo จังหวัด Rizal จากมาตรการกักกันเพื่อป้องกันอหิวาตกโรคในแหล่งน้ำของกรุงมะนิลา
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan 25.000 peso Filipina atau jumlah yang diperlukan untuk mengganti kerugian pemilik tanah dan penduduk Mariquina dan San Mateo, Provinsi Rizal, akibat karantina untuk melindungi pasokan air Manila dari kolera
title.ms: Akta memperuntukkan 25,000 peso Filipina atau jumlah yang diperlukan untuk membayar pampasan kepada pemilik tanah dan penduduk Mariquina dan San Mateo, Wilayah Rizal, akibat kuarantin bagi melindungi bekalan air Manila daripada taun

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
in part compensation for the service of the municipal government of the city of Manila for the fiscal year
ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and five, the sum of twenty-five thousand pesos, Philippine currency,
or so much thereof as may be necessary, for the payment of claims for damages sustained by the landowners
and residents of the municipalities of Mariquina and San Mateo, including those made by the landowners
and residents of the former municipality of Montalban, now a barrio of the municipality of San Mateo in the
Province of Rizal, on account of the quarantine measures adopted by the Insular Government to protect the
water supply of the city of Manila from infection with cholera. The payment of claims as hereby authorized
shall be made upon the order of the Municipal Board of the city of Manila after due investigation, and the
funds hereby appropriated shall be disbursed by the disbursing officer of said board.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 26, 1904.
